categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Modifies core RPC parameter parsing and validation infrastructure in src/rpc/util.cpp, src/rpc/server.cpp, and src/rpc/client.cpp.
categories.rationale: Extending the RPC framework to support distinct types per parameter alias and oneOf schemas improves interface consistency and unblocks parameter additions in PR #32857. As described, the RPC framework previously lacked support for per-alias type checks, preventing methods from cleanly migrating positional booleans to options objects.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Changes the wallet RPC interface and spend logic in src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp for walletprocesspsbt.
categories.rationale: Adopting an options parameter for walletprocesspsbt replaces clumsy boolean chains and unblocks planned parameter expansions such as PR #32857. The description notes that positional calls currently require multiple sequential booleans ('walletprocesspsbt "psbt" true "ALL" true false') and adding further settings without an options object becomes increasingly unwieldy.
